NHL Hockey - Winnipeg Jets at Detroit Red Wings

The Detroit Red Wings clash with the Winnipeg Jets at Little Caesars Arena. Detroit looks to build on a 5-1 win in their last meeting led by Alex DeBrincat's 41-goal season, while Winnipeg counters behind Mark Scheifele's 103-point campaign.
NFL Football - Dallas Cowboys at Houston Texans

The Texans host the Cowboys at NRG Stadium in Week 4. Last week, Houston's offense struggled in a 19-17 loss to Indianapolis where the Texans managed only 223 total yards. Dallas also fell last week, despite 267 passing yards from QB Dak Prescott.
NFL Football - Denver Broncos at San Francisco 49ers

The San Francisco 49ers host the Denver Broncos at Levi's Stadium. San Francisco enters Week 4 having won all three of its games, while Denver has won two of three. The 49ers lead the NFC West rankings, while the Broncos sit third in the AFC West.

NFL Football - Detroit Lions at Carolina Panthers

The Detroit Lions clash with the Carolina Panthers in Week 4 at Bank of America stadium. Detroit enters following a 31-24 win over the Jets on September 27, while host Carolina aims to bounce back from a 21-18 loss to Cleveland the same day.
